content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and one plan filed per rule.

**Highlights for the review team:**

- **Located and mapped:** LOL-CAP (§14.5, p0602 — mutual consequential-damages waiver; no dollar cap surfaced), INDEMN (§§14.1–14.3), GOVLAW (New York law p0627, but confidential arbitration at §15.6 with redacted seat), ASSIGN (§15.2, p0608–p0614), IP (§10.1 from p0422), LICENSE (Article III, p0247–p0265), AUDIT (§9.9, p0415–p0419, apparently mutual and auditor-cost-shifted), WARRANTY (Article XIII incl. broad §13.5 disclaimer p0574), INSURANCE (§14.6 p0603), TRANSITION (§12.3 consequences p0500–p0516).
- **Indirect restrictions on us:** NONCOMPETE and T4C both key off Article XII — §12.2(d) (p0493) lets RevMed terminate if Sanofi pursues a Competing Product, with adverse consequences at p0500. Flagged to avoid double-counting the same commercial term against ASSIGN's change-of-control mechanics.
- **Likely absent:** MFN, NOSOLICIT, LD, MINCOMMIT (only diligence at §5.7 and milestones — not take-or-pay), and RENEWAL (term runs to royalty expiry; no auto-renewal mechanic, so the rule is inapplicable rather than breached).
